Draft document.description: Start a canonical draft with an explicit unresolved decision.
body: scope "${3:Describe the behavior included in this slice.}"

Canonical function.description: Define a canonical function with requirement coverage and a prose body.

Informal function.description: Define a return-first function with a plain-English body.

Prose step.description: Describe an ordered operation in plain English.

Prose block.description: Describe a control block in English and nest prose or exact logic inside it.

Requirement.description: Record observable behavior with a stable requirement ID.

Open question.description: Record an unresolved decision in a draft document.
body: open ${1:Q1} "${2:What decision needs to be made?}"$0

Ask question.description: Mark where a declared open question prevents completing the logic.

Source reference.description: Add a source locator to replace with an actual project path and symbol.

Operation port.description: Describe an outside operation's effects and observable contract.
body: contract "${6:Describe outputs, effects, and relevant failure behavior.}"

Scenario.description: Describe scenario input and an expected expression.

Conditional.description: Branch on an exact condition and describe its behavior.

Iteration.description: Iterate over values and describe the operation for each value.
